categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in intelligent steel bar processing equipment manufacturing, focusing on CNC steel bar processing robotic equipment and related software. Its product lines include single-piece steel bar forming machines, combined steel bar forming machines, and steel bar strengthening machines. The company also provides integrated intelligent steel bar processing factory solutions for various infrastructure and construction sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced CNC technology, digital program control, and automation in steel bar processing, including bending, straightening, cutting, welding, and forming. It integrates mechanical, electrical, and software systems to achieve high automation and precision. The company emphasizes green, low-carbon manufacturing and digital transformation, utilizing robotics, AI, and IoT for intelligent production lines and smart factory solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned enterprises and major private companies in infrastructure construction such as China Railway, China Railway Construction, China State Construction, and others. End markets cover high-speed railways, highways, bridges, tunnels, subways, underground utility corridors, nuclear power, hydropower, ports, airports, and prefabricated buildings. The company also exports to over 100 countries, including more than 80 Belt and Road Initiative countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing in Tianjin. It has subsidiaries across multiple provinces and a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong. Its products are sold domestically and internationally, with exports to Japan, South Korea, Israel, Italy, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, Russia, and other countries, covering over 100 countries worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of intelligent steel bar processing equipment. It procures raw materials and components, assembles and tests equipment, and sells directly to infrastructure construction companies and steel processing centers. It also provides integrated solutions and after-sales services, positioning itself as a key equipment supplier in the steel reinforcement processing industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include technological leadership in intelligent steel bar processing robotics, global market expansion especially along the Belt and Road, and sustainable green development aligned with China's dual carbon goals. R&D focuses on digitalization, automation, energy efficiency, and product innovation such as smart production lines for T-beams and high-speed rail box girders. The company invests heavily in R&D, maintaining over 600 patents and software copyrights, and collaborates with top universities for talent and technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of intelligent CNC steel bar processing equipment and related software solutions. The company uses a combination of stock-based and order-based production models, with direct sales as the main channel supplemented by distributors. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company also earns income from after-sales services, spare parts, and integrated factory solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic and global player in intelligent steel bar processing equipment, recognized as the largest in China and among the top globally. It holds a strong brand reputation and long-term relationships with major infrastructure enterprises. Its products are competitive in performance and price, often replacing imported equipment. The company actively participates in industry standard setting, reinforcing its leadership position. Competitors include hundreds of smaller domestic manufacturers, but few match its technological and product breadth.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 451.18 million, a slight decrease of 2.12% from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 44.81 million, down 22.13%. The company maintains a solid asset base of about RMB 1.25 billion and equity of RMB 964 million. R&D investment increased by 20.81% to RMB 35.86 million, representing 7.95% of revenue. The company shows stable cash flow generation and continues to invest in capacity expansion and technology development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high automation, precision, and energy efficiency in its intelligent steel bar processing equipment, offering superior product performance at competitive prices. Its integrated digital and green manufacturing solutions enable customers to achieve digital transformation and low-carbon production. The company’s extensive patent portfolio, comprehensive product range, and strong after-sales service network differentiate it from competitors. It positions itself as a trusted partner for large infrastructure projects, delivering customized, flexible, and sustainable solutions.
